review_candidates.title: Community Experience Lead
review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Community Experience Lead based in South Africa. As Community Experience Lead, you will own the long-term strategy and vision for a growing, multi-market community. You will shape the experience across the entire talent journey, from initial engagement and learning through to lifelong alumni participation. Leading a small, high-performing team, you will combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution and people development. You will work closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to align priorities, secure resources, and strengthen community impact. Data, member insights, and continuous improvement will guide your decisions and help demonstrate results. This is an opportunity to build scalable community systems while empowering local teams and members to create meaningful connections. The role is fully remote and suited to an autonomous, digitally connected professional comfortable working across regions and time zones. Accountabilities Define and drive the long-term Community Experience strategy, ensuring it remains member-led, locally relevant, and embedded throughout the full talent lifecycle. Develop and manage a strategic roadmap covering initiatives such as learner and alumni engagement, ambassador programmes, engagement tracking, knowledge hubs, and community resources. Translate organisational priorities into clear community goals, plans, and investments, adapting the strategy as needs, budgets, and operating conditions evolve. Lead and develop a small community team through clear objectives, regular feedback, coaching, performance management, and professional development. Recruit and onboard additional community talent as the function grows, defining roles and resourcing needs in line with strategic priorities. Remove execution blockers by resolving cross-functional dependencies, prioritisation challenges, and resource constraints. Support and coach city-based Community Managers and Ambassadors, helping establish consistent standards, tools, and effective ways of working. Act as the central voice for Community across the organisation, building strong partnerships with teams across loyalty, alumni relations, regional operations, brand, product, and learning delivery. Represent Community priorities in leadership and planning discussions, securing stakeholder alignment, investment, and resources. Identify and manage risks related to member engagement and communications, ensuring outreach remains coordinated and sustainable. Own community performance reporting, including engagement, member satisfaction, programme impact, trends, and opportunities for improvement. Establish and monitor KPIs, translating performance data into clear recommendations and narratives for senior stakeholders. Manage the Community budget, including forecasting, expenditure tracking, and prioritisation of investments when resources are limited. Benchmark community practices and engagement approaches against comparable organisations and incorporate relevant external insights into future strategy. Requirements 5+ years of experience in community management, programme management, operations, or a related field, including at least 2 years in a people-management or team-leadership capacity. Experience in education, technology, membership-based organisations, or similarly community-driven environments is highly valuable. Proven ability to develop a strategy and turn it into an actionable roadmap that can be delivered by a small team. Strong experience managing, coaching, and developing direct reports through goal setting, feedback, performance reviews, and career development. Excellent stakeholder-management and influencing skills, with the ability to gain alignment from senior leaders and cross-functional teams without relying on direct authority. Strong analytical and reporting capabilities, including defining KPIs, monitoring performance, interpreting trends, and communicating impact to non-technical stakeholders. Hands-on experience with online community platforms such as Discourse, Circle, Slack, Discord, or similar tools. Familiarity with member communications and engagement tools, including newsletter and email platforms such as Mailchimp or HubSpot. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to represent community priorities across a distributed organisation. Ability to operate comfortably at both strategic and operational levels, moving between long-term planning, people leadership, and day-to-day problem solving. Strong organisational skills, self-motivation, and the ability to work independently in a fully remote, digital-first environment. Ability to collaborate effectively across multiple locations, cultures, and time zones. Passion for community building, collaboration, inclusion, and creating meaningful member experiences. Experience with community-led growth, ambassador, referral, or engagement programmes is a plus. Experience with data visualisation or engagement analytics tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar is advantageous. Background in budget management, programme investment, behavioural psychology, retention strategies, or multi-market distributed organisations is beneficial. Benefits Fully remote working environment with flexibility to work digitally across locations and time zones. High level of autonomy and ownership, with the opportunity to shape the community function and its long-term direction. Opportunity to lead and develop a high-performing team while influencing community strategy across multiple markets. Collaborative, impact-driven environment focused on innovation, experimentation, data, and continuous improvement. Exposure to cross-functional leadership and the opportunity to influence organisational priorities at a senior level. Opportunity to contribute to programmes designed to expand access to technology skills and strengthen career opportunities across Africa. Flexible, digital-first ways of working supported by tools such as Zoom, Slack, and Gmail. Full-time position with a strong emphasis on accountability, initiative, and sustainable performance. Opportunities to build scalable community programmes, develop new approaches, and make a measurable impact on learner and alumni engagement. review_candidates.title: Chef d’équipe réseaux électriques B2T - Ancenis-Saint-Géréon F/H
review_candidates.location: Ancenis-Saint-Géréon, Pays de la Loire, France
review_candidates.description: Rejoignez MIGEN MIGEN est un acteur majeur de la prestation de maintenance industrielle, en forte croissance et dirigé par des hommes et des femmes de terrain. Nous accompagnons nos clients industriels grâce à des équipes techniques spécialisées, principalement dans les métiers de la maintenance industrielle, de l’électromécanique, de l’automatisme et de la robotique. Dans le cadre du développement ponctuel de nos activités, nous ouvrons exceptionnellement un poste de Chargé de travaux électriques spécialisé en travaux sous tension basse tension (B2T) . Ce poste vient compléter notre expertise terrain et répond à des besoins spécifiques de nos clients en matière de travaux, de modification, de dépannage et d'interventions électriques en basse tension. Rejoindre MIGEN, c’est intégrer une entreprise à taille humaine, proche du terrain, où la sécurité, l’expertise technique et la qualité des interventions sont au cœur de notre fonctionnement. Vous habitez à Ancenis-Saint-Géréon ou à proximité ? Ce poste est basé à Ancenis-Saint-Géréon et les interventions se concentrent sur le secteur. Vos missions Vous intervenez chez nos clients industriels et tertiaires pour des travaux neufs, des modifications d'installation et du dépannage en basse tension. En tant que Chargé de travaux , vous êtes responsable de la préparation, de l'organisation et de la sécurité des interventions, de l'analyse des risques jusqu'à la remise de l'ouvrage. Préparation et sécurité Prendre connaissance de l'ouvrage et des contraintes du site et réaliser les visites préalables avec le client. Réaliser les analyses de risques et définir les modes opératoires. Définir la zone de travail et le balisage. Déterminer les conditions d'exécution du travail (CET) applicables aux opérations sous tension et en vérifier la faisabilité. Recevoir l'attestation de consignation ou l'autorisation de travail. Assurer la relation avec le chargé d'exploitation électrique du site. Contrôler l'adéquation, la validité et l'état du matériel, de l'outillage isolé, des VAT, EPI et EPC. Conduite des travaux Donner les consignes de sécurité aux exécutants, répartir les tâches et surveiller en permanence leur réalisation. Réaliser les interventions électriques : raccordements, reprises de départs, remplacement d'appareillage, câblage d'armoires et de TGBT, distribution, éclairage et alimentation de machines. Diagnostiquer et dépanner les installations BT, y compris en régime dégradé et sous contrainte de production. Réaliser les mesures, essais et contrôles avant remise en service. Procéder à la remise de l'ouvrage au client. Suivi et relation client Rédiger les comptes rendus d'intervention, relevés et rapports de mesure. Mettre à jour les schémas et le DOE. Assurer l'interface technique quotidienne avec le client. Identifier et remonter les éventuels besoins complémentaires au service coordination. Participer à la démarche QHSE : port des EPI, remontée des situations dangereuses et quarts d'heure sécurité. Votre profil Vous êtes issu(e) d'une formation Bac Pro MELEC, BTS Électrotechnique, BTS Maintenance des Systèmes ou disposez d'une expérience équivalente. Vous justifiez d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience en électricité industrielle ou tertiaire , avec une pratique confirmée des travaux sous tension BT . Vous disposez de l'habilitation B2T . Vous maîtrisez : La lecture et l'interprétation des schémas électriques. Les régimes de neutre, l'appareillage BT et les dispositifs de protection. Les opérations de dépannage et d'intervention sur installations électriques BT. La préparation et l'organisation de travaux électriques. L'encadrement d'une petite équipe. Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre rigueur, votre sens des responsabilités et votre capacité à garder votre sang-froid face aux aléas . Votre sens du service client, votre pédagogie et votre aisance rédactionnelle seront également importants dans ce poste. Prérequis Habilitation B2T en cours de validité selon la norme NF C 18-510. Formation TST BT à jour, avec recyclage de moins de 3 ans. Permis B indispensable. Aptitude médicale compatible avec les travaux sous tension et le travail en hauteur. Les habilitations B2V, BR, BC, H0V , ainsi que le CACES R486 catégorie B, l'AIPR et le SST sont appréciés. Les formations nécessaires peuvent être complétées ou financées à l'embauche. Rémunération et avantages 34 000 à 40 000 € brut annuels, sur 12 mois, selon votre expérience, vos habilitations et votre niveau d'autonomie. Paniers repas. Indemnités de déplacement selon la grille en vigueur. Astreintes et interventions ponctuelles le week-end rémunérées. Mutuelle d'entreprise et prévoyance. Camion nacelle mis à disposition de l'équipe. Téléphone, tablette et outillage individuel fournis. Intégration accompagnée par le service coordination et binôme lors des premières interventions. Poste basé à Nantes (44), avec déplacements quotidiens sur un rayon d'environ 60 km.

Sous la responsabilité hiérarchique du Responsable du Produit "Planification" d’EDF IN, en tant que chef de projet international, vous : Participez, dans la phase de montage de l'offre, à la construction de la réponse aux appels d’offres en lien avec les équipes commerciales. La maîtrise de la langue anglaise est souhaitable et la pratique d’une autre langue (espagnol, portugais, …) est un plus. Idéalement, le candidat a une expérience internationale (emploi, stage, semestre d’étude, …) ou baigne dans un environnement multiculturel. Compétences transverses : Autonomie, Capacité d'adaptation, Capacité d'analyse / Esprit de synthèse, Travail en équipe, Sens du client.

With a strong focus on research and innovation to support education and sustainable development, UM6P boasts a state-of-the-art campus and infrastructure. It has built a robust academic and research network and is committed to recruiting high-quality academics and professionals to contribute to its dynamic, quality-driven research environment. Job Description The Energy4Water (E4W) at UM6P is seeking applications for two Postdoctoral Researcher positions to support its growing research portfolio in renewable energy-driven water production and condensation-based system optimization . The positions are designed for early-career scientists with a strong background in thermal sciences, energy systems, or water technologies, and a demonstrated ability to operate in research environments oriented toward sustainability and impact. The selected researchers will contribute to both experimental and modeling activities involving sorption and condensation technologies, solar thermal integration, and system optimization. Responsibilities will include laboratory investigations, prototyping, field testing, and performance analysis of water harvesting systems across various climatic contexts. In line with E4W’s mission, the postdoctoral researchers will engage with academic, industrial, and institutional partners to translate research into real-world applications that advance water access, environmental resilience, and green innovation. Key Duties The successful candidate will carry out duties to the highest standard and will: Undertake original research of international excellence in the domain of renewable energy-powered water harvesting systems. Design and model advanced systems based on condensation, sorption, or hybrid thermal processes using solar and alternative energy sources. Conduct laboratory investigations and field trials to assess the efficiency, reliability, and scalability of water harvesting technologies across different environmental conditions. Analyze material-system interactions, particularly the performance of adsorbents, thermal interfaces, and condensation surfaces under varied operating scenarios. Develop and refine performance simulation models and predictive tools to support system optimization and deployment strategies. Prepare high-quality scientific publications and contribute to the dissemination of research outcomes through leading journals, national/international conferences, and technical forums. Develop research objectives and technical proposals independently and collaboratively, aligned with the strategic priorities of the E4W initiative. Engage actively with the E4W project team, ensuring timely and accurate communication of experimental progress, results, and potential implementation challenges. Identify opportunities for structural and methodological improvement across research workflows through integrated project management and quality control practices. Foster collaborative linkages with other programmatic areas, core scientific teams, and external partners to strengthen conceptual frameworks and accelerate cross-disciplinary innovation. Contribute to capacity building by mentoring junior researchers, interns, and students within the project ecosystem. Support, where applicable, the development of funding proposals, grant applications, and stakeholder engagement materials to sustain and expand research activities. Candidate Profile PhD in related fields Excellent communication in both English and French languages. Good publication record in peer-reviewed journals. The ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary and multicultural team. Excellent networking ability and organizational skills. Capacities in co-supervision and coordination of masters and PhD level students Proven ability of working with team members and PhD students to help build their research skills and knowledge and to support and guide their professional development. Creating links, and build upon existing ideas to generate novelty in concepts and solutions.
